description: This Perl module implements a class for storing Memoize cache data in YAML format by tying a hash to a YAML file. It provides methods for hashing, retrieving, storing, checking existence, and cleanup that automatically read from and write to the YAML file.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Memoize::YAML
classes.description: A Perl class for tying hashes to YAML files for persistent caching in Memoize.

methods.name: TIEHASH
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object by loading data from a YAML file or creating an empty hash.

methods.name: STORE
methods.description: Stores a value in the hash, updating the tied hash.

methods.name: FETCH
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the hash.

methods.name: EXISTS
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the hash.

methods.name: DESTROY
methods.description: Dumps the hash to the YAML file when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: SCALAR
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the hash.

methods.name: FIRSTKEY
methods.description: Provides a placeholder string for hash iteration.

methods.name: NEXTKEY
methods.description: Placeholder for hash iteration, returns undef.
